CHAPTER 15 · ITEM 07 / 14

Shutdown, exit and supply

Operating at a loss虧損下營運

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Distinguish operating at a loss from shutting down: a firm may continue if revenue covers variable costs and contributes toward fixed costs.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

虧損本身不足以判斷停產。收入涵蓋 VC 並支付部分 FC 時，營運虧損較少；把兩個方案利潤直接比較最清楚。

A loss does not by itself imply shutdown. If revenue covers VC and some FC, operating reduces the loss compared with paying all FC without production. Compare the two profit levels explicitly.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：TR=150,VC=100,FC=100. Operate: profit=−50. Shutdown: profit=−100. Continue this period.

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

TR=90,VC=70,FC=40. Operating profit versus shutdown? 營運和停產利潤？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
